test_artifact_cleanup: test that old artifact directories are deleted when ProgramDatabase save is called with cleanup enabled
configure_database_cleanup: create a DatabaseConfig with cleanup_old_artifacts enabled and set artifact_retention_days to control retention
run_program_database_save: run the ProgramDatabase save method to trigger artifact cleanup of old directories
test_DatabaseConfig_retention: test the DatabaseConfig artifact_retention_days setting to verify old artifacts are removed after the retention period
review_ProgramDatabase_cleanup: review the ProgramDatabase save method to verify it cleans up artifact directories older than the retention period
